# JWT Security Check

> Paste a JWT to decode it and flag misconfigurations: alg:none, embedded keys, algorithm confusion, suspicious kid, bad exp. Free, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/jwt-security-check/)
- [How to decode a JWT without a tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/jwt-security-check/how-to-decode-a-jwt-without-a-tool.html)
- [JWT Security Check vs. eyeballing the payload](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/jwt-security-check/vs-eyeballing-the-payload.html)
